title: Can I MASTER MORE Drawback Chess?
summary: More games of Drawback Chess on the Drawback Chess site vs anonymous humans; each side has a hidden handicap. Drawbacks seen: Savior Complex; Lethal Attraction; Conscientious Objectors.
rules: Standard chess moves on 8x8, but there is no check or checkmate: you win by capturing the enemy king.
Each player is secretly assigned a random 'drawback' rule restricting their play; violating it is illegal (or loses, as the drawback states).
Opponent's drawback is revealed at game end.
Difficulty slider (Easy-Hard) chooses drawback severity; players rate drawbacks thumbs up/down.

Drawbacks seen in this video: Savior Complex: when in check, you must move your queen (or lose) | Lethal Attraction: you can't make moves that place the moving piece farther from the opponent's king than it started | Conscientious Objectors: you can't capture with pawns
win_condition: Capture the opponent's king (result screen 'You took your opponent's king').

opponent.name: anonymous human (brave orange elephant, angry green kangaroo)

board.theme_notes: cream/brown board on purple Drawback UI

visual_fx: highlighted restricted squares (e.g. pink volcano squares)
